ValidationRule.description: PacPoint-DN12032020 - Created for PVL Sprint 7 Phase 1
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
AND(
OR( AND (LicenseType__r.Name="DIS", ISBLANK (NumberofMVDs__c),NOT(ISPICKVAL(Phase__c, "A - Application Received"))),
AND (LicenseType__r.Name="DIS", NumberofMVDs__c=0,NOT(ISPICKVAL(Phase__c, "A - Application Received"))),
AND (LicenseType__r.Name="F", ISBLANK (NumberofMVDs__c), NOT(ISPICKVAL(Phase__c, "A - Application Received"))),
AND (LicenseType__r.Name="F", NumberofMVDs__c=0,NOT(ISPICKVAL(Phase__c, "A - Application Received")))
),
AND( TEXT(Status__c) <> "HD - Application Terminated", TEXT(Type__c) <> "RNEW - Renewal" )
)
ValidationRule.errorMessage: The Number of MVDs is Required Before Moving to the Next Phase.
